question: As per Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, what is the total length of National Highways in India as of November 2022?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**1,44,634 kilometres**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of **November 2022**, the total length of **National Highways in India** is officially recorded as **1,44,634 kilometres**, according to the **Ministry of Road Transport and Highways**.
 
• India has one of the largest road networks in the world, and the **National Highways** play a crucial role in connecting major cities, ports, industrial hubs, and tourist destinations.
 
• The development and maintenance of National Highways are managed under the purview of the **Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)**.
 
• National Highways constitute about **2% of India's total road network** but carry nearly **40% of the road traffic**, highlighting their significance in the country's infrastructure.
 
• The expansion of National Highways is a critical component of the government's **Bharatmala Pariyojana**, which aims to enhance road connectivity and logistics efficiency across the country.
 
• In recent years, India has focused on improving the **quality and capacity** of its highways to support its growing economy and population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Incorrect Options**

 
 
• Options mentioning different numerical values such as **1,85,633 kilometres**, **1,45,897 kilometres**, or **1,86,908 kilometres** are incorrect as they do not match the officially recorded figure of **1,44,634 kilometres**.
 
• These numbers might represent speculative or unofficial data, but the **Ministry of Road Transport and Highways** provides the most accurate and updated information regarding the length of National Highways.
 
 
 
• **Importance of National Highways**
 
 
• National Highways are categorized as the primary roads for long-distance travel and movement of goods across states.
 
• They are critical for the economic growth of India and serve as a backbone for **trade and logistics**.
 
• The highways also improve connectivity in remote areas, boosting regional development and accessibility.
